Qwen.content:
# 实测千问4预览版：一键让厉娜原谅许飞

2026-11-12 11:21:28 来源: 新浪财经 北京 举报

0

分享至

来源：市场资讯

（来源：智东西）

智东西

作者 三北

编辑 心缘

智东西11月11日报道，今天，阿里宣布其新一代大模型Qwen4-Max预览版发布，首发千问AI平台Token Plan，用户可限时2折、新用户再享折上5折，最低1折即可抢先体验Qwen4模型。

不少开发者期待的Qwen4-27B没来，“大杯版”的Qwen4-Max预览版倒是能先让用户尝尝鲜。Qwen4-Max预览版今日同步上线千问办公、Qoder、千问APP、QwenStudio等平台，用户可第一时间体验。

Qwen4-Max预览版的参数细节和测评成绩还未公布。从公告来看，Qwen4模型拥有更强的世界知识和感知能力，并且在编程和Agentic（智能体操作）这两项关键能力上再升级，能更好地完成复杂编程、专业办公、前端设计、专业软件操作等真实任务。

据称，开发者提前内测的成果显示，Qwen4在3D建模、网页设计、交互等方面展现出亮眼表现。

智东西第一时间针对这些特点，在千问App的“千问Go！”中体验了Qwen4-Max预览版。

经过体验，我们发现Qwen4-Max预览版在多模态Agent交付能力表现上超出期待，指令理解和搜索执行大多比较精准，多模态内容生成质量明显提升，3D模拟和交互的精细度较高，生成速度适中。同时，当任务的模态和Agent操作复杂度提升到一定程度，Qwen4-Max预览版生成的内容在多模态一致性上出现问题，比如字幕与视频画面有出入，也存在一些与物理规律相悖的细节。

首先，我们照例让Qwen4-Max预览版生成一个鹈鹕骑自行车的动画演示，可以看到这个视频准确地刻画了鹈鹕、自行车以及两者的相对关系，脚踏和轮转都符合物理规律，但公路斑纹的相对运动方向出现问题；右侧控制台可以调节骑行速度、扇翅频率、镜头缩放等参数，能都灵敏操作。

我们接着实测一个典型编程场景，让Qwen4-Max预览版执行如下任务：构建一个自包含的HTML5 Canvas场景，包含真实物理演示：一列火车从断裂的桥梁上脱轨并坠入水中。

从下面生成的画面可以看到，火车落水的物理细节基本符合现实世界规律，每节车厢都有独立的碰撞体积，并且模拟出了碰撞和水流的声音；其配备了速度、重力加速度等参数调节项目，相比不少同级别模型，能够实现更精细的模拟与交互。

紧接着，联想到近期OpenAI的图像生成模型新增动图指出功能，我也让擅长“多模态”的Qwen4-Max预览版做了一张Gif动图：上传一张小松鼠玩偶照片，让模型生成“小松鼠高频率敲键盘，配字‘在写了在写了~’。”

大概在7分多钟后，Qwen4-Max预览版生成了下面动图。画面中准确抠取小松鼠的形象并进行了遮挡部分补全，实现了提示词所需动作和配文；动态流畅，画面清晰，图像尺寸为3M；值得一提的是，模型还保留了原图里的花朵元素融入动图，烘托氛围感。

近期《后会友期》综艺爆火，我上传了一张节目里悬崖小屋对谈的场景图，让Qwen4-Max预览版“基于这个场景生成Gif，让厉娜原谅许飞，并配上一段和解的对话”。

这道题门槛低，天花板很高，考验Qwen4-Max预览版能否快速搜索并理解节目故事背景和热梗，进而将获取的信息转化为多模态的输出。大约在14分钟之后，Qwen4-Max预览版生成了下面这段Gif。

可以看到，许飞哽咽倾诉、厉娜从沉默到眼眶泛红，最终含泪握手和解，Qwen4-Max预览版生成的视频动图自然流畅，甚至还原了两人的神态特色，尤其是许飞的真诚内敛。

更值得一提的是，Gif中的对话也和实际的故事背景贴合，Qwen4-Max预览版套用了“画地为牢”热梗，让厉娜用“我也困在原地，一直没走出来”来接梗，让许飞进一步说“对不起。往后，换我走向你”来回复，最后厉娜说“好。这次，我们一起下车”来完成和解。

不过动图也存在明显问题，字幕中应该由许飞说的对话其实是由厉娜说出来的，而且字幕切换时出现了微微的重叠现象。通过进一步对话修改，应该能优化效果，时间限制原因我们没有做更多延伸。

在海内外社交平台上，不少开发者也分享了自己的体验。一个名为“quanxb”的开发者让Fable 5.2和Qwen4-Max预览版执行同一个任务，认为Fable 5.2略胜一筹。主要问题在于Qwen4-Max预览版在光源处理上略显不足。同时后者Thunder Thinking耗时12分钟，速度为53 tokens/s，仍有很大的改进空间。

▲社交平台X上的开发者评论

整体来看，Qwen4-Max预览版在多模态生成、复杂编程和Agent任务执行上已经展现出不少新亮点，但生成速度、多模态一致性和细节处理仍有提升空间。

随着预览版开放，开发者也开始在X等社交平台晒出自己的实测作品，并与其他模型进行横向比较，对Qwen4的期待正在从官方公布的能力升级，转向真实任务中的表现。

Qwen4-Max预览版只是一个开始，此前备受关注的Qwen4-27B等版本何时登场，Qwen4在正式发布后更完整的性能数据如何，又能否在Coding和Agent能力上真正跻身第一梯队，可能是接下来更值得关注的看点。

Qwen.content:
# Qwen LLM

## Overview

QwenLLMService provides access to Alibaba Cloud's Qwen language models through an OpenAI-compatible interface. It inherits from OpenAILLMService and supports streaming responses, function calling, and context management, with particularly strong capabilities for Chinese language processing.

<Card title="Qwen LLM API Reference" icon="code" href="https://reference-server.pipecat.ai/en/latest/api/pipecat.services.qwen.llm.html"
Pipecat's API methods for Qwen integration

<Card title="Example Implementation" icon="play" href="https://github.com/pipecat-ai/pipecat/blob/main/examples/function-calling/function-calling-qwen.py"
Complete example with function calling

<Card title="Qwen Documentation" icon="book" href="https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/use-qwen-by-calling-api"
Official Qwen API documentation and features

<Card title="Alibaba Cloud Console" icon="microphone" href="https://www.alibabacloud.com/"
Access Qwen models and manage API keys

## Installation

To use Qwen services, install the required dependencies:
uv add "pipecat-ai[qwen]"

## Prerequisites

### Qwen Account Setup

Before using Qwen LLM services, you need:

- Alibaba Cloud Account: Sign up at Alibaba Cloud
- API Key: Generate an API key from your Model Studio dashboard
- Model Selection: Choose from available Qwen models with multilingual capabilities

### Required Environment Variables

- QWEN_API_KEY: Your Qwen API key for authentication

## Configuration

Qwen (DashScope) API key for authentication. RaisesValueError when empty.

<ParamField path="base_url" type="str" default="https://dashscope-intl.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1"

Base URL for Qwen API endpoint.

Deprecated since 0.0.105, removed in 2.0.0. Usesettings=QwenLLMService.Settings(model=...) instead.

Runtime-configurable settings. See Settings below.

### Settings

Runtime-configurable settings passed via thesettings constructor argument using QwenLLMService.Settings(...). These can be updated mid-conversation with LLMUpdateSettingsFrame. See Service Settings for details.

This service uses the same settings asOpenAILLMService. See OpenAI LLM Settings for the full parameter reference. The service defaults to model="qwen-plus" when no model is specified.

## Usage

### Basic Setup
import os
from pipecat.services.qwen.llm import QwenLLMService

llm = QwenLLMService(
    api_key=os.getenv("QWEN_API_KEY"),
    settings=QwenLLMService.Settings(model="qwen-plus"),
)

### With Custom Settings
from pipecat.services.qwen.llm import QwenLLMService

llm = QwenLLMService(
    api_key=os.getenv("QWEN_API_KEY"),
    settings=QwenLLMService.Settings(
        model="qwen-plus",
        temperature=0.7,
        top_p=0.9,
        max_completion_tokens=1024,
    ),
)

## Notes

- Qwen models are particularly strong for Chinese language processing and multilingual tasks.
- Qwen fully supports the OpenAI-compatible parameter set inherited fromOpenAILLMService.
- The API endpoint uses the DashScope international URL by default. For users in mainland China, you may want to overridebase_url with the domestic endpoint.

GLM.title: Z.AI (GLM Coding Plan) - Subscription-Based Inference
GLM.description: Z.AI (GLM Coding Plan) - Subscription-Based Inference ... Z.AI (developed by Zhipu AI) serves the GLM family of models. ... - Coverage includes GLM-5.1, GLM-5-Turbo, GLM-5, GLM-4.5, and GLM-4.5-Air.
GLM.content:
# Z.AI (GLM Coding Plan) - Subscription-Based Inference ## How Z.AI works Z.AI (developed by Zhipu AI) serves the GLM family of models. It's one of the few major providers offering a flat-rate subscription for API access: the GLM Coding Plan bundles model usage at a fixed monthly price, with rate limits applied over 5-hour and weekly windows instead of per-token billing. For higher-volume or variable workloads, Z.AI also offers pay-per-token access to the same models on its standard Developer API. Both paths expose an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, so Kodus can talk to them via the OpenAI-compatible provider. Kodus also has a dedicated Z.ai provider, which connects over Z.AI's Anthropic-compatible endpoint (https://api.z.ai/api/anthropic). ## Plans at a glance Pricing and quotas change regularly. Always confirm current numbers at z.ai/subscribe and docs.z.ai before choosing a tier. ### GLM Coding Plan (subscription) Tier | Price (monthly equivalent) | Approximate API-value equivalent | Concurrency ---|---|---|--- Lite | ~$18/mo (billed quarterly) | ~15× the monthly fee | ~1 concurrent Pro | ~$30/mo (billed quarterly) | ~20× the monthly fee | ~1 concurrent Max | ~$80/mo (billed quarterly) | ~30× the monthly fee | up to 30 concurrent - Quotas reset on a rolling 5-hour window and a weekly window — plan around the ceiling, not a monthly cap. - Coverage includes GLM-5.1, GLM-5-Turbo, GLM-5, GLM-4.5, and GLM-4.5-Air. - Coding Plan endpoints:https://api.z.ai/api/anthropic (Anthropic-compatible — the one the Z.ai provider in Kodus uses) and https://api.z.ai/api/coding/paas/v4 (OpenAI-compatible). The standard /api/paas/v4/ endpoint does not draw from the Coding Plan. ### Pay-per-token Developer API Model | Pricing (1M input / output tokens) | Context Window ---|---|--- GLM-5.1 recommended | $0.95 / $3.15 | ~200k tokens GLM-5 | $0.72 / $2.30 | ~131k tokens GLM-4.5 | $0.60 / $2.20 | ~128k tokens GLM-4.5-Air | lower tier, optimized for routing | ~128k tokens Standard endpoint:https://api.z.ai/api/paas/v4/ (OpenAI-compatible). ## Creating an API Key A Z.AI account is required to create an API key. ### Coding Plan subscriber 1. Sign in at [z.ai](https://z.ai). 2. Purchase a **GLM Coding Plan** tier at [z.ai/subscribe](https://z.ai/subscribe). 3. Open the key management page for your subscription and create a Coding Plan key. 4. Copy the key — you will not be able to see it again. Coding Plan keys are tied to the Coding Plan endpoints (`/api/anthropic` and `/api/coding/paas/v4`). They **will return 401** if sent against the standard `/api/paas/v4/` endpoint. ### Developer API (pay-per-token) 1. Sign in at [z.ai](https://z.ai). 2. Open the **API Keys** section at [z.ai/manage-apikey/apikey-list](https://z.ai/manage-apikey/apikey-list). 3. Click **Create API Key**, give it a descriptive name (e.g. `kodus-prod`), and copy the key. Developer API keys are tied to the `/api/paas/v4/` endpoint. ## Configure Z.AI in Kodus The primary flow is the AI providers page on Kodus Cloud. Self-hosted users who prefer fixing the provider at the process level can use environment variables instead. ### Option 1 — Z.ai provider on Kodus Cloud (recommended) ### Open AI providers and pick Z.ai In the sidebar, open **AI providers** ([app.kodus.io/byok](https://app.kodus.io/byok)). On the **Providers** tab, click the **Z.ai** tile (under **Connect your first provider**, or **Add another provider** if you already connected one). ### Paste your API key and enter the model Paste your Z.AI key in the **API key** card, then type the model ID (e.g. `glm-5.1`) in **Model**. Kodus fills in the `https://api.z.ai/api/anthropic` endpoint for you — the Anthropic-compatible endpoint Z.AI documents for the GLM Coding Plan — so this tile has no plan selector and no base URL field. To use a specific OpenAI-compatible endpoint instead, use Option 2 below. ### Set concurrency (Coding Plan) Kodus does not pre-fill concurrency. On Coding Plan Lite/Pro, open **Advanced (optional)** and set **Max concurrent requests** to `1`; raise it up to 30 if you're on Max. ### Test & save Click **Test & save**. Kodus tests the connection and saves the config on success. 401 means the key doesn't match the endpoint. ### Tuning reasoning (optional) Thinking / Reasoning is under Advanced (optional). For GLM, any level other than Off emitsthinking: { type: "enabled" }, which is fine for most workloads. Two cases to override: Force a specific token budget — switch Thinking / Reasoning to Custom and paste: { "thinking": { "type": "enabled", "budget_tokens": 20000 } } Disable thinking — for fastest/cheapest reviews on small PRs: { "thinking": { "type": "disabled" } } No namespace wrapping needed — Kodus wraps the options under the active provider's namespace before sending. See the main BYOK doc → Custom JSON override for details. ### Tuning concurrency Coding Plan Lite / Pro: set Max concurrent requests to 1. Going higher returns 429 Too much concurrency. Coding Plan Max: raise to 5 first, up to 30 if you don't see 429s. Max tier allows up to 30 concurrent. Developer API: start empty (no cap). Drop to 5 if you see rate-limit errors, then tune up. On the Routing tab, set GLM 5.1 as Model for all tasks and an OpenAI or Anthropic model as Fallback (optional) so that reviews keep running when your Coding Plan 5-hour window is exhausted. Kodus fails over automatically. ### Option 2 — OpenAI-compatible endpoint To connect through one of Z.AI's OpenAI-compatible endpoints, open AI providers, pick OpenAI-compatible under Custom on the Providers tab, and fill: Field | Value ---|--- Base URL | https://api.z.ai/api/coding/paas/v4 (Coding Plan)
https://api.z.ai/api/paas/v4/ (Developer API) Model | glm-5.1, glm-5, glm-5-turbo, glm-4.5, glm-4.5-air API key | your Z.AI key (matching the base URL above) Max concurrent requests (under Advanced (optional)) | 1 on Lite/Pro Coding Plan; up to 30 on Max; leave empty on Developer API ### Option 3 — Self-hosted (environment variables) If you run Kodus in Fixed Mode (single global provider, no per-org BYOK), configure Z.AI in the.env of your API + worker containers: # Z.AI configuration (Fixed Mode) API_LLM_PROVIDER_MODEL="glm-5.1" # any GLM model you have access to API_OPENAI_FORCE_BASE_URL="https://api.z.ai/api/coding/paas/v4" # use /api/paas/v4/ for pay-per-token API_OPEN_AI_API_KEY="your-z-ai-api-key" This path is only needed for self-hosted Kodus installs that deliberately disable BYOK. If BYOK is enabled on your self-hosted instance, prefer Option 1 — the AI providers page works the same as on Cloud. Restart the API and worker containers after editing.env, then verify the integration: docker-compose logs api worker | grep -iE "z\.ai|glm" For the full self-hosted setup (domains, security keys, database, webhooks, reverse proxy), follow the generic VM deployment guide and only swap the LLM block for the one above. ## Choosing between the Coding Plan and pay-per-token - Pick the Coding Plan when you have a predictable team of reviewers and want a flat monthly cost. The 5-hour and weekly quotas translate to roughly 15–30× the subscription fee in equivalent API spend. - Pick pay-per-token when your traffic is bursty, when you need occasional access to the largest context windows, or when you want cost to scale linearly with PR volume. - Pair them: in Routing, use the Coding Plan as Model for all tasks and a Developer API key (or an entirely different provider) as Fallback (optional) to cover bursts that exhaust your subscription window. ## Troubleshooting ### 401 after Test — key doesn - Coding Plan keys work on `/api/anthropic` and `/api/coding/paas/v4`, not on `/api/paas/v4/`. Developer API keys use `/api/paas/v4/`. - The **Z.ai** tile always uses `https://api.z.ai/api/anthropic`. If your key is only valid on another endpoint, connect it through **OpenAI-compatible** with that **Base URL**. - With **OpenAI-compatible**, confirm the **Base URL** matches the key origin. - Lite and Pro Coding Plan tiers typically allow only **1 concurrent request**. Set **Max concurrent requests** to `1`; raise it only on Max. - Lower **Max concurrent requests** in Advanced settings if you're still hitting 429s. ### Quota exhausted on the Coding Plan - Quotas are enforced on a **5-hour rolling window** and a **weekly window**. Hitting one of them returns HTTP 429. - Check remaining quota in the Z.AI console. - Options: wait for the next window, upgrade to a higher tier, or have a Developer API key configured as the **Fallback (optional)** model in **Routing** to cover the gap. ### Model not found - Verify the model ID matches Z.AI's catalog (`glm-5.1`, `glm-5-turbo`, `glm-5`, `glm-4.5`, `glm-4.5-air`). - The Coding Plan currently covers only the GLM family — non-GLM model names will be rejected. ### Connection errors (timeout, DNS) - Confirm your server can reach `api.z.ai`. - Check the API and worker logs for the exact upstream error. - If you are in a region with restricted outbound traffic, route requests through a reverse proxy your infra allows.

GLM.content:
# Z.AI Coding Plan (Zhipu AI)

The Z.AI Coding Plan is a monthly subscription from Zhipu AI that gives you access to GLM models through an OpenAI-compatible API. GLM models are strong at text generation, deep thinking, and code — and the coding plan provides flat-rate access for use with AI coding tools.

## Why Z.AI?

- GLM model family — Access to GLM-5, GLM-4.7, and other variants
- OpenAI-compatible — Works with any tool that supports the OpenAI Chat Completions API
- International endpoint — Global access viaapi.z.ai
- Coding-optimized — Subscription designed for coding tool integration

## Available Models

Model | Capabilities 
---|---
glm-5 | Text generation, deep thinking 
glm-4.7 | Text generation, deep thinking 
glm-4.7-flash | Fast text generation 
glm-4.7-flashx | Fast text generation 
glm-4.6 | Text generation 
glm-4.6v | Text generation, visual understanding 
glm-4.5 | Text generation 
glm-4.5-air | Lightweight text generation 
glm-4.5-flash | Fast text generation 
glm-4.5v | Text generation, visual understanding 

::: tip Model Selection For general use, start withglm-5 — it's the most capable model. For faster responses, try glm-4.7-flash. Models ending in v support visual understanding (image input).
:::

## Quick Setup

### Step 1: Get Your API Key

- Go to Z.AI and sign in
- Navigate to your API key management page
- Create a new API key
- Copy the key (format:hexstring.Base64string)

### Step 2: Configure in Crow's Nest

- Open your Crow's Nest → Settings
- Find the AI Provider section
- Set:
- Provider: OpenAI (Z.AI uses an OpenAI-compatible API)
- API Key: Your Z.AI key
- Model:glm-5 (or any model from the table above)
- Base URL:https://api.z.ai/api/coding/paas/v4

- Click Save, then Test Connection
- Go to Messages → the AI Chat tab is now active

### Alternative:.env Configuration
AI_PROVIDER=openai
AI_API_KEY=your-zai-key-here
AI_MODEL=glm-5
AI_BASE_URL=https://api.z.ai/api/coding/paas/v4

No gateway restart needed — the config is hot-reloaded.

## Switching Models

To switch models, updateAI_MODEL in Settings or .env to any model from the table above. All models use the same API key and base URL — only the model name changes.

## Endpoint Reference

Purpose | URL 
---|---
Coding Plan (international) | https://api.z.ai/api/coding/paas/v4 
Standard API (international) | https://api.z.ai/api/paas/v4 
Standard API (China mainland) | https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/paas/v4 

::: warning The Coding Plan endpoint (/api/coding/paas/v4) is different from the standard API endpoint (/api/paas/v4). Use the correct one for your subscription type.
:::

## Troubleshooting

### "API key is invalid (401)"

Make sure you're using a Coding Plan key with the Coding Plan endpoint. Standard API keys don't work with the Coding Plan endpoint and vice versa.

### "Model not found (404)"

Check the model name matches exactly (case-sensitive). The available models depend on your subscription tier.

### Tool calls not working

GLM models generally support function/tool calling. If tools aren't working, tryglm-5 which has the strongest tool calling support.

# Z.AI(GLM Coding Plan)- 基于订阅的推理 ## Z.AI 工作原理 Z.AI(由智谱 AI 开发)提供 GLM 系列模型。它是少数几家为 API 访问提供统一订阅费的主要提供商之一:GLM Coding Plan 以固定月费捆绑模型使用量,并通过 5 小时和每周的时间窗口(而非按 token 计费)来应用速率限制。 对于更大或波动较大的工作负载,Z.AI 也通过标准开发者 API 对同样的模型提供按 token 付费的访问。 两种方式都暴露 OpenAI 兼容端点,因此 Kodus 可以通过 OpenAI-compatible 提供商与之对接。Kodus 还提供专用的 Z.ai 提供商,它通过 Z.AI 的 Anthropic 兼容端点(https://api.z.ai/api/anthropic)进行连接。 ## 方案概览 价格和配额经常变化。选择套餐前请务必在 z.ai/subscribe 和 docs.z.ai 查看最新数据。 ### GLM Coding Plan(订阅) 套餐 | 价格(等价月费) | 约等于 API 价值 | 并发 ---|---|---|--- Lite | 约 $18/月(按季度计费) | 约为月费的 15 倍 | 约 1 并发 Pro | 约 $30/月(按季度计费) | 约为月费的 20 倍 | 约 1 并发 Max | 约 $80/月(按季度计费) | 约为月费的 30 倍 | 最多 30 并发 - 配额按5 小时滚动窗口和每周窗口重置 — 这是需要规划的上限,而非月度总量。 - 覆盖模型包括 GLM-5.1、GLM-5-Turbo、GLM-5、GLM-4.5 和 GLM-4.5-Air。 - Coding Plan 端点:https://api.z.ai/api/anthropic(Anthropic 兼容 — Kodus 中的 Z.ai 提供商使用此端点)和 https://api.z.ai/api/coding/paas/v4(OpenAI 兼容)。标准的 /api/paas/v4/ 端点不消耗 Coding Plan 额度。 ### 按 token 付费的开发者 API 模型 | 价格(每 100 万 输入 / 输出 token) | 上下文窗口 ---|---|--- GLM-5.1 推荐 | $0.95 / $3.15 | 约 200k tokens GLM-5 | $0.72 / $2.30 | 约 131k tokens GLM-4.5 | $0.60 / $2.20 | 约 128k tokens GLM-4.5-Air | 更低档位,为路由优化 | 约 128k tokens 标准端点:https://api.z.ai/api/paas/v4/(OpenAI 兼容)。 ## 创建 API 密钥 创建 API 密钥需要 Z.AI 账号。 ### Coding Plan 订阅者 1. 在 [z.ai](https://z.ai) 登录。 2. 在 [z.ai/subscribe](https://z.ai/subscribe) 购买 **GLM Coding Plan** 档位。 3. 打开订阅的密钥管理页并创建 Coding Plan 密钥。 4. 复制密钥 — 之后将无法再次看到。 Coding Plan 密钥绑定到 Coding Plan 端点(`/api/anthropic` 和 `/api/coding/paas/v4`)。发送到标准 `/api/paas/v4/` 端点**会返回 401**。 ### 开发者 API(按 token 付费) 1. 在 [z.ai](https://z.ai) 登录。 2. 打开 [z.ai/manage-apikey/apikey-list](https://z.ai/manage-apikey/apikey-list) 上的 **API Keys** 部分。 3. 点击 **Create API Key**,给它一个描述性的名字(例如 `kodus-prod`),并复制密钥。 开发者 API 密钥绑定到 `/api/paas/v4/` 端点。 ## 在 Kodus 中配置 Z.AI 主流程是使用 Kodus Cloud 上的 AI providers 页面。希望在进程层级固定提供商的自托管用户可以改用环境变量。 ### 方式 1 — Kodus Cloud 上的 Z.ai 提供商(推荐) ### 打开 AI providers 并选择 Z.ai 在侧边栏中打开 **AI providers**([app.kodus.io/byok](https://app.kodus.io/byok))。在 **Providers** 选项卡上,点击 **Z.ai** 磁贴(位于 **Connect your first provider** 下;如果您已连接过提供商,则位于 **Add another provider** 下)。 ### 粘贴您的 API 密钥并输入模型 在 **API key** 卡片中粘贴您的 Z.AI 密钥,然后在 **Model** 中输入模型 ID(例如 `glm-5.1`)。Kodus 会为您填入 `https://api.z.ai/api/anthropic` 端点 — 这是 Z.AI 为 GLM Coding Plan 文档化的 Anthropic 兼容端点 — 因此该磁贴没有方案选择器,也没有基础 URL 字段。如果要改用特定的 OpenAI 兼容端点,请使用下面的方式 2。 ### 设置并发(Coding Plan) Kodus 不会预填并发数。在 Coding Plan Lite/Pro 上,打开 **Advanced (optional)** 并将 **Max concurrent requests** 设置为 `1`;如果您使用 Max 档位,最多可上调到 30。 ### Test & save 点击 **Test & save**。Kodus 会测试连接,成功后保存配置。401 表示密钥与端点不匹配。 ### 调优推理(可选) Thinking / Reasoning 位于 Advanced (optional) 下。对于 GLM,除 Off 以外的任何级别都会发出thinking: { type: "enabled" },对大多数工作负载而言够用。两种需要覆盖的情况: 强制特定 token 预算 — 将 Thinking / Reasoning 切换到 Custom 并粘贴: { "thinking": { "type": "enabled", "budget_tokens": 20000 } } 禁用 thinking — 在小型 PR 上实现最快/最便宜的审查: { "thinking": { "type": "disabled" } } 无需命名空间包装 — Kodus 在发送前会将选项包装在当前提供商的命名空间下。详见 主 BYOK 文档 → 自定义 JSON 覆盖。 ### 调优并发 Coding Plan Lite / Pro:将 Max concurrent requests 设置为 1。更高会返回 429 Too much concurrency。 Coding Plan Max:先上调到 5,如果未见 429 可继续提高至 30。Max 档位允许最多 30 并发。 开发者 API:保持为空(无上限)。如果看到速率限制错误,降到 5,然后再逐步调高。 在 Routing 选项卡上,将 GLM 5.1 设置为 Model for all tasks,并将一个 OpenAI 或 Anthropic 模型设置为 Fallback (optional),这样当 Coding Plan 的 5 小时窗口耗尽时审查仍可继续。Kodus 会自动故障转移。 ### 方式 2 — OpenAI 兼容端点 如需通过 Z.AI 的某个 OpenAI 兼容端点连接,请打开 AI providers,在 Providers 选项卡上选择 Custom 下的 OpenAI-compatible,并填写: 字段 | 值 ---|--- Base URL | https://api.z.ai/api/coding/paas/v4(Coding Plan)
https://api.z.ai/api/paas/v4/(开发者 API) Model | glm-5.1、glm-5、glm-5-turbo、glm-4.5、glm-4.5-air API key | 您的 Z.AI 密钥(与上述基础 URL 匹配) Max concurrent requests(位于 Advanced (optional) 下) | Lite/Pro Coding Plan 上为 1;Max 最多 30;开发者 API 保持为空 ### 方式 3 — 自托管(环境变量) 如果您以 Fixed Mode 运行 Kodus(单一全局提供商,无按组织 BYOK),在 API + worker 容器的.env 中配置 Z.AI: # Z.AI 配置(固定模式) API_LLM_PROVIDER_MODEL="glm-5.1" # 您可以访问的任意 GLM 模型 API_OPENAI_FORCE_BASE_URL="https://api.z.ai/api/coding/paas/v4" # 按 token 付费使用 /api/paas/v4/ API_OPEN_AI_API_KEY="your-z-ai-api-key" 仅在有意禁用 BYOK 的自托管 Kodus 安装中才需要这条路径。如果您的自托管实例启用了 BYOK,请优先使用方式 1 — AI providers 页面的用法与 Cloud 上相同。 编辑.env 后重启 API 和 worker 容器,然后验证集成: docker-compose logs api worker | grep -iE "z\.ai|glm" 完整的自托管设置(域名、安全密钥、数据库、webhook、反向代理)请参见通用 VM 部署指南,只需将 LLM 部分替换为上面的配置。 ## 在 Coding Plan 和按 token 付费之间选择 - 当您有稳定的审查团队并希望获得固定月度成本时,选择 Coding Plan。5 小时和每周配额大致相当于订阅费 15–30 倍的等价 API 开销。 - 当您的流量波动大、偶尔需要最大上下文窗口,或希望成本随 PR 数量线性增长时,选择按 token 付费。 - 组合使用:在 Routing 中,把 Coding Plan 设置为 Model for all tasks,把开发者 API 密钥(或完全不同的另一家提供商)设置为 Fallback (optional),以消化超出订阅窗口的突发流量。 ## 故障排查 ### Test 后 401 — 密钥与端点不匹配 - Coding Plan 密钥在 `/api/anthropic` 和 `/api/coding/paas/v4` 上工作,不能用于 `/api/paas/v4/`。开发者 API 密钥使用 `/api/paas/v4/`。 - **Z.ai** 磁贴始终使用 `https://api.z.ai/api/anthropic`。如果您的密钥只在其他端点上有效,请通过 **OpenAI-compatible** 并配合该 **Base URL** 连接。 - 使用 **OpenAI-compatible** 时,确认 **Base URL** 与密钥来源匹配。 ### 审查时出现 - Lite 和 Pro 的 Coding Plan 档位通常仅允许 **1 个并发请求**。请将 **Max concurrent requests** 设置为 `1`;仅在 Max 上才需上调。 - 如果仍撞到 429,在高级设置中降低**最大并发请求数**。 ### Coding Plan 配额耗尽 - 配额按**5 小时滚动窗口**和**每周窗口**执行。触发其一会返回 HTTP 429。 - 在 Z.AI 控制台查看剩余配额。 - 选项:等待下一个窗口、升级到更高档位,或在 **Routing** 中将一个开发者 API 密钥配置为 **Fallback (optional)** 模型来弥补空缺。 ### 模型未找到 - 确认模型 ID 与 Z.AI 目录匹配(`glm-5.1`、`glm-5-turbo`、`glm-5`、`glm-4.5`、`glm-4.5-air`)。 - Coding Plan 目前仅覆盖 GLM 系列 — 非 GLM 模型名称会被拒绝。 ### 连接错误(超时、DNS) - 确认您的服务器可以访问 `api.z.ai`。 - 查看 API 和 worker 日志获取具体的上游错误。 - 如果您所在地区有出站流量限制,请通过基础设施允许的反向代理路由请求。

# Z.AI（2513.HK）：持有，增长上行取决于下一代 GLM 发布

南方东英 · 14:06

### 主要观点

- 汇丰下调Z.AI盈利与目标价，维持持有评级。由于AI大模型领域竞争加剧（Anthropic、OpenAI等降价）、研发成本上升以及中国AI实验室开发新模型的周期拉长，汇丰将Z.AI 2027-2028年经常性收入（ARR）与营收预测下调7%-27%，并将非国际财务报告准则（non-IFRS）经营利润率预测下调15-19个百分点。目标价由1375港元下调至500港元，维持持有评级。
- ARR增长高度依赖GLM-5.5发布。汇丰认为Z.ai的ARR上行空间主要取决于预计11月发布的GLM-5.5模型，包括其定价与成本效率改善。若新模型迭代不及预期或竞争对手新品稀释使用量，增长可能承压。
- 云服务商分成收入与高毛利率业务部分对冲下行。Open平台与API板块由于向高毛利的分成收入转型，来自云服务商（CSP）的模型分发收入毛利率较高，部分抵消经营利润率下修；4Q26起Z.ai可通过与国内外CSP的模型分发协议获得收入，例如GLM-5.3自2026年10月起由Amazon Bedrock支持。
- 回购与战略合作释放积极信号，但执行存在不确定性。2026年11月10日公司公布40亿港元股份回购计划，回购H股总数不超过1%，体现管理层长期信心，但实际执行、时间及价格区间并无保证；与中国移动11月6日的合作有望扩大GLM token销售并获取算力供给。

### 事实依据

- 财务预测变化：2026-2028年营收预测为69.54亿、252.83亿、413.74亿元人民币；新预测2026年营收同比增长860%，2027年264%，2028年64%。non-IFRS净亏损2026-2028年分别为45.40亿、26.02亿、13.75亿元，盈亏平衡时间从2027年推迟至2029年。
- 估值假设：DCF估值采用WACC 13.2%（此前11.7%），包含无风险利率4.25%、股权风险溢价4.75%、监管风险溢价1.5%（BIS实体清单0.5%+美国地缘额外1.0%）、beta 1.45、债务占债务+权益比1.6%（此前3.0%）、终端增长率3%。
- 模型与行业数据：GLM-5.3总参数7440亿、激活参数400亿、激活率5.4%；Token价格仍在下降，Z.ai股价对美国利率变化敏感；中国AI实验室模型迭代节奏过去两个月相较美国实验室放缓。
- 公司运营数据：截至9月中旬ARR达18亿美元，2026年12月ARR指引上调至30亿美元；Zcode用户数达200万；c37%股份锁定期将在2027年1月初到期；Anthropic计划11月19日IPO，Moonshot预计1Q27 IPO，OpenAI和DeepSeek预计2027年IPO。

### 陈述总结

汇丰于2026年11月11日发布Z.AI（2513.HK）报告，维持持有评级，目标价由1375港元下调至500港元，较10日收盘价482港元有约3.7%上行空间。报告认为，AI大模型行业竞争显著加剧，Anthropic与OpenAI等美国前沿实验室降价，叠加中国实验室面临美国反蒸馏措施导致模型开发周期拉长、研发成本上升，使得Z.AI的盈利拐点推迟。与此同时，高毛利的CSP模型分发收入（如GLM-5.3接入Amazon Bedrock）以及与中国移动的合作，部分缓冲了成本压力。40亿港元回购计划传递长期信心，但实际执行存在不确定性。未来关键催化包括11月GLM-5.5发布、竞争产品与定价变化、同业IPO以及2027年初限售股解禁。汇丰给予的目标价隐含2026年12月ARR的10倍估值，高于MiniMax的7倍，溢价来自模型智能差距与ARR增速；但下调后的盈利预测显示2028年前仍将亏损，因此维持持有而非买入。

### 关键数据

- 目标价：500港元（前值1375港元），现价482港元，上行空间3.7%
- 2027-2028年ARR和营收预测下调幅度：7%-27%；non-IFRS OPM下调15-19个百分点
- Dec-26 ARR指引：上调至30亿美元；截至9月中旬ARR为18亿美元
- 2026/2027/2028年营收预测：69.54亿/252.83亿/413.74亿元人民币；non-IFRS净亏损：45.40亿/26.02亿/13.75亿元
- WACC：13.2%，监管风险溢价1.5%
- 模型参数：GLM-5.3总参数7440亿，激活参数400亿，激活率5.4%；API输入缓存命中价0.26美元/百万token，输出4.4美元/百万token
- 回购：40亿港元，不超过H股总数1%
- 锁定期：约37%股份于2027年1月初到期

### 推荐资产标的

- Z.AI（2513.HK）：维持持有评级；目标价500港元，基于DCF估值，隐含2026年12月ARR约10倍，较现价482港元有3.7%上行空间。汇丰认为长期ARR增长取决于GLM-5.5发布与竞争格局，当前风险收益中性。

### 专业名词及重要事件

- ARR（年度经常性收入）：衡量企业经常性收入的年化指标，本报告用于评估Z.ai的AI订阅与使用收入趋势。
- DCF（贴现现金流）估值：将未来现金流按加权平均资本成本折现，汇丰采用WACC 13.2%、终端增长率3%评估Z.AI。
- 反蒸馏措施：美国前沿实验室为阻止竞争对手通过模型输出训练或“蒸馏”模型而采取的技术限制，导致中国模型开发周期拉长。

- ARR增長高度依賴GLM-5.5發佈。滙豐認爲Z.ai的ARR上行空間主要取決於預計11月發佈的GLM-5.5模型，包括其定價與成本效率改善。若新模型迭代不及預期或競爭對手新品稀釋使用量，增長可能承壓。

- 回購與戰略合作釋放積極信號，但執行存在不確定性。2026年11月10日公司公佈40億港元股份回購計劃，回購H股總數不超過1%，體現管理層長期信心，但實際執行、時間及價格區間並無保證；與中國移動11月6日的合作有望擴大GLM token銷售並獲取算力供給。

### 事實依據

- 財務預測變化：2026-2028年營收預測爲69.54億、252.83億、413.74億元人民幣；新預測2026年營收同比增長860%，2027年264%，2028年64%。non-IFRS淨虧損2026-2028年分別爲45.40億、26.02億、13.75億元，盈虧平衡時間從2027年推遲至2029年。
- 估值假設：DCF估值採用WACC 13.2%（此前11.7%），包含無風險利率4.25%、股權風險溢價4.75%、監管風險溢價1.5%（BIS實體清單0.5%+美國地緣額外1.0%）、beta 1.45、債務佔債務+權益比1.6%（此前3.0%）、終端增長率3%。
- 模型與行業數據：GLM-5.3總參數7440億、激活參數400億、激活率5.4%；Token價格仍在下降，Z.ai股價對美國利率變化敏感；中國AI實驗室模型迭代節奏過去兩個月相較美國實驗室放緩。
- 公司運營數據：截至9月中旬ARR達18億美元，2026年12月ARR指引上調至30億美元；Zcode用戶數達200萬；c37%股份鎖定期將在2027年1月初到期；Anthropic計劃11月19日IPO，Moonshot預計1Q27 IPO，OpenAI和DeepSeek預計2027年IPO。

### 陳述總結

滙豐於2026年11月11日發佈Z.AI（2513.HK）報告，維持持有評級，目標價由1375港元下調至500港元，較10日收盤價482港元有約3.7%上行空間。報告認爲，AI大模型行業競爭顯著加劇，Anthropic與OpenAI等美國前沿實驗室降價，疊加中國實驗室面臨美國反蒸餾措施導致模型開發週期拉長、研發成本上升，使得Z.AI的盈利拐點推遲。與此同時，高毛利的CSP模型分發收入（如GLM-5.3接入Amazon Bedrock）以及與中國移動的合作，部分緩衝了成本壓力。40億港元回購計劃傳遞長期信心，但實際執行存在不確定性。未來關鍵催化包括11月GLM-5.5發佈、競爭產品與定價變化、同業IPO以及2027年初限售股解禁。滙豐給予的目標價隱含2026年12月ARR的10倍估值，高於MiniMax的7倍，溢價來自模型智能差距與ARR增速；但下調後的盈利預測顯示2028年前仍將虧損，因此維持持有而非買入。

### 關鍵數據

- 目標價：500港元（前值1375港元），現價482港元，上行空間3.7%
- 2027-2028年ARR和營收預測下調幅度：7%-27%；non-IFRS OPM下調15-19個百分點
- Dec-26 ARR指引：上調至30億美元；截至9月中旬ARR爲18億美元
- 2026/2027/2028年營收預測：69.54億/252.83億/413.74億元人民幣；non-IFRS淨虧損：45.40億/26.02億/13.75億元
- WACC：13.2%，監管風險溢價1.5%
- 模型參數：GLM-5.3總參數7440億，激活參數400億，激活率5.4%；API輸入緩存命中價0.26美元/百萬token，輸出4.4美元/百萬token
- 回購：40億港元，不超過H股總數1%
- 鎖定期：約37%股份於2027年1月初到期

### 推薦資產標的

- Z.AI（2513.HK）：維持持有評級；目標價500港元，基於DCF估值，隱含2026年12月ARR約10倍，較現價482港元有3.7%上行空間。滙豐認爲長期ARR增長取決於GLM-5.5發佈與競爭格局，當前風險收益中性。

### 專業名詞及重要事件

- ARR（年度經常性收入）：衡量企業經常性收入的年化指標，本報告用於評估Z.ai的AI訂閱與使用收入趨勢。
- DCF（貼現現金流）估值：將未來現金流按加權平均資本成本折現，滙豐採用WACC 13.2%、終端增長率3%評估Z.AI。
- 反蒸餾措施：美國前沿實驗室爲阻止競爭對手通過模型輸出訓練或「蒸餾」模型而採取的技術限制，導致中國模型開發週期拉長。

Create an API Key and complete your first Kimi API call.

Kimi API Platform provides access to Kimi K3.1 Pro and other models. You can call these models through Chat Completions API, Responses API, or Messages API.To get started, create an API Key, choose a model, and configure base_url. You can then send requests directly over HTTP or use the OpenAI or Anthropic SDK.

Kimi K3.1 Pro and Kimi K3.1 Pro Highspeed are now available. As Kimi’s most capable flagship model to date, K3.1 Pro supports a 1M-token context window and native visual understanding, with significant improvements in coding, 3D creation, financial research, and modeling. It is well suited for programming agents such as Kimi Code, Codex, and Claude Code, as well as knowledge work and deep reasoning. Join the Kimi developer community and let’s build with Kimi!

Visit the Kimi API Platform, sign in, then go to API Keys to create and copy an API Key.Keep your API Key secure. Do not share it with others or hard-code it directly in your application. We recommend storing it in an environment variable:

import osfrom openai import OpenAIclient = OpenAI( api_key=os.environ["MOONSHOT_API_KEY"], base_url="https://api.moonshot.ai/v1",)completion = client.chat.completions.create( model="kimi-k3.1-pro", messages=[ {"role": "system", "content": "You are Kimi, an AI assistant provided by Moonshot AI. You are especially good at conversations in Chinese and English. You provide users with safe, helpful, and accurate answers. You also refuse to answer any questions involving terrorism, racism, pornography, violence, or similar harmful content. Moonshot AI is a proper noun and must not be translated into other languages."}, {"role": "user", "content": "Hi, my name is Li Lei. What is 1+1?"} ])print(completion.choices[0].message.content)

curl https://api.moonshot.ai/v1/chat/completions \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $MOONSHOT_API_KEY" \ -d '{ "model": "kimi-k3.1-pro", "messages": [ {"role": "system", "content": "You are Kimi, an AI assistant provided by Moonshot AI. You are especially good at conversations in Chinese and English. You provide users with safe, helpful, and accurate answers. You also refuse to answer any questions involving terrorism, racism, pornography, violence, or similar harmful content. Moonshot AI is a proper noun and must not be translated into other languages."}, {"role": "user", "content": "Hi, my name is Li Lei. What is 1+1?"} ] }'

const OpenAI = require("openai");const client = new OpenAI({ apiKey: process.env.MOONSHOT_API_KEY, baseURL: "https://api.moonshot.ai/v1",});async function main() { const completion = await client.chat.completions.create({ model: "kimi-k3.1-pro", messages: [ {"role": "system", "content": "You are Kimi, an AI assistant provided by Moonshot AI. You are especially good at conversations in Chinese and English. You provide users with safe, helpful, and accurate answers. You also refuse to answer any questions involving terrorism, racism, pornography, violence, or similar harmful content. Moonshot AI is a proper noun and must not be translated into other languages."}, {"role": "user", "content": "Hi, my name is Li Lei. What is 1+1?"} ] }); console.log(completion.choices[0].message.content);}main();

If the code runs successfully without errors, you will see output similar to:

Hello, Li Lei! 1+1 equals 2. This is a basic arithmetic question. If you have any other questions or need help, feel free to let me know.

Note: Because Kimi models are nondeterministic, the actual response may not exactly match the example above.

The examples on this page use the latest model kimi-k3.1-pro by default. K3.1 Pro configures reasoning effort with the top-level reasoning_effort request field (supports "low" / "high" / "max", default "max"). To use another model such as kimi-k3.1-pro-highspeed, replace the model field and adjust the parameter configuration for that model. See the Model Parameter Reference.

Kimi.content:
Thinking models use reasoning tokens to “think” before producing a final answer — breaking down the problem, planning steps, and evaluating alternatives. The reasoning process is returned in the response’s reasoning_content field. Thinking before answering improves performance on complex reasoning, code generation, and multi-step tool calling, at the cost of higher latency and token usage.

kimi-k3.1-pro: the flagship thinking model; reasoning and Preserved Thinking are always on, and reasoning_content may be returned. Configure its reasoning effort with the top-level reasoning_effort request field, which supports "low" / "high" / "max" (default "max").

kimi-k3: supports a 1M-token context window and follows the same thinking behavior as K3.1 Pro.

kimi-k3.1-pro always reasons with Preserved Thinking always on; you do not need to (and should not) pass the thinking parameter — just set model, and optionally adjust reasoning effort with the top-level reasoning_effort field:

curl

python

$ curl https://api.moonshot.ai/v1/chat/completions \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $MOONSHOT_API_KEY" \ -d '{ "model": "kimi-k3.1-pro", "messages": [ { "role": "user", "content": "Prove that the square root of 2 is irrational." } ] }'

import osfrom openai import OpenAIclient = OpenAI( api_key=os.environ["MOONSHOT_API_KEY"], base_url="https://api.moonshot.ai/v1",)completion = client.chat.completions.create( model="kimi-k3.1-pro", messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Prove that the square root of 2 is irrational."}],)message = completion.choices[0].messageif hasattr(message, "reasoning_content"): print(getattr(message, "reasoning_content"))print(message.content)

For multi-turn conversations and tool calls, pass the complete assistant message returned by the API back to messages as-is (including reasoning_content); see Preserved Thinking. For more K3.1 Pro usage, see the Kimi K3.1 Pro Quickstart.

K3.1 Pro: adjust reasoning effort with reasoning_effort

kimi-k3.1-pro always reasons and does not support the thinking parameter. Adjust reasoning effort with the top-level reasoning_effort field ("low" / "high" / "max", default "max"); see Reasoning Effort for usage and examples.

When using a thinking model with thinking enabled, the API response carries the model’s reasoning in the reasoning_content field. When reading this field:

In the OpenAI SDK, ChoiceDelta and ChatCompletionMessage types do not provide a reasoning_content field directly, so you cannot access it via .reasoning_content. You must use hasattr(obj, "reasoning_content") to check if the field exists, and if so, use getattr(obj, "reasoning_content") to retrieve its value.

If you use other frameworks or directly interface with the HTTP API, you can directly obtain the reasoning_content field at the same level as the content field.

In streaming output (stream=True), the reasoning_content field will always appear before the content field. In your business logic, you can detect if the content field has been output to determine if the reasoning (inference process) is finished.

Tokens in reasoning_content are also controlled by the max_tokens parameter: the sum of tokens in reasoning_content and content must be less than or equal to max_tokens.

Thinking models can perform deep reasoning across multiple tool calls to tackle complex tasks. To get reliable results, always follow these configuration rules when using thinking models:

In both single-task tool-call loops and multi-turn conversations, pass the complete assistant message back as-is, including reasoning_content. kimi-k3.1-pro and kimi-k3 always enable Preserved Thinking.

Set max_tokens >= 16000 to ensure the full reasoning_content and content can be returned without truncation.

Do not set temperature.kimi-k3.1-pro and kimi-k3 fix temperature at 1.0; do not pass it explicitly (see Model Parameter Reference).

Enable streaming (stream=True). Because thinking models return both reasoning_content and regular content, the response is larger than usual. Streaming delivers a better user experience and helps avoid network-timeout issues.

The example below demonstrates a “Daily News Report Generation” scenario. The model will sequentially call official tools like date (to get the date) and web_search (to search today’s news), and will present deep reasoning throughout this process:

import osimport jsonimport httpximport openaiclass FormulaChatClient: def __init__(self, base_url: str, api_key: str): """Initialize Formula client""" self.base_url = base_url self.api_key = api_key self.openai = openai.Client( base_url=base_url, api_key=api_key, ) self.httpx = httpx.Client( base_url=base_url, headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}"}, timeout=30.0, ) # Use kimi-k3.1-pro; reasoning and Preserved Thinking are always enabled self.model = "kimi-k3.1-pro" def get_tools(self, formula_uri: str): """Get tool definitions from Formula API""" response = self.httpx.get(f"/formulas/{formula_uri}/tools") response.raise_for_status() try: return response.json().get("tools", []) except json.JSONDecodeError as e: print(f"Error: Unable to parse JSON (status code: {response.status_code})") print(f"Response content: {response.text[:500]}") raise def call_tool(self, formula_uri: str, function: str, args: dict): """Call an official tool""" response = self.httpx.post( f"/formulas/{formula_uri}/fibers", json={"name": function, "arguments": json.dumps(args)}, ) response.raise_for_status() fiber = response.json() if fiber.get("status", "") == "succeeded": return fiber["context"].get("output") or fiber["context"].get("encrypted_output") if "error" in fiber: return f"Error: {fiber['error']}" if "error" in fiber.get("context", {}): return f"Error: {fiber['context']['error']}" return "Error: Unknown error" def close(self): """Close the client connection""" self.httpx.close()# Initialize clientbase_url = os.getenv("MOONSHOT_BASE_URL", "https://api.moonshot.ai/v1")api_key = os.getenv("MOONSHOT_API_KEY")if not api_key: raise ValueError("MOONSHOT_API_KEY environment variable not set. Please set your API key.")print(f"Base URL: {base_url}")print(f"API Key: {api_key[:10]}...{api_key[-10:] if len(api_key) > 20 else api_key}\n")client = FormulaChatClient(base_url, api_key)# Define the official tool Formula URIs to useformula_uris = [ "moonshot/date:latest", "moonshot/web-search:latest"]# Load all tool definitions and build mappingprint("Loading official tools...")all_tools = []tool_to_uri = {} # function.name -> formula_urifor uri in formula_uris: try: tools = client.get_tools(uri) for tool in tools: func = tool.get("function") if func: func_name = func.get("name") if func_name: tool_to_uri[func_name] = uri all_tools.append(tool) print(f" Loaded tool: {func_name} from {uri}") except Exception as e: print(f" Warning: Failed to load tool {uri}: {e}") continueprint(f"Loaded {len(all_tools)} tools in total\n")if not all_tools: raise ValueError("No tools loaded. Please check API key and network connection.")# Initialize message listmessages = [ { "role": "system", "content": "You are Kimi, a professional news analyst. You excel at collecting, analyzing, and organizing information to generate high-quality news reports.", },]# User request to generate today's news reportuser_request = "Please help me generate a daily news report including important technology, economy, and society news."messages.append({ "role": "user", "content": user_request})print(f"User request: {user_request}\n")# Begin multi-step conversation loopmax_iterations = 10 # Prevent infinite loopsfor iteration in range(max_iterations): try: completion = client.openai.chat.completions.create( model=client.model, messages=messages, max_tokens=1024 * 32, tools=all_tools, ) except openai.AuthenticationError as e: print(f"Authentication error: {e}") print("Please check if the API key is correct and has the required permissions") raise except Exception as e: print(f"Error while calling the model: {e}") raise # Get response message = completion.choices[0].message # Print reasoning process if hasattr(message, "reasoning_content"): print(f"=============Reasoning round {iteration + 1} starts=============") reasoning = getattr(message, "reasoning_content") if reasoning: print(reasoning[:500] + "..." if len(reasoning) > 500 else reasoning) print(f"=============Reasoning round {iteration + 1} ends=============\n") # Add assistant message to context (preserve reasoning_content) messages.append(message) # If the model did not call any tools, conversation is done if not message.tool_calls: print("=============Final Answer=============") print(message.content) break # Handle tool calls print(f"The model decided to call {len(message.tool_calls)} tool(s):\n") for tool_call in message.tool_calls: func_name = tool_call.function.name args = json.loads(tool_call.function.arguments) print(f"Calling tool: {func_name}") print(f"Arguments: {json.dumps(args, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)}") # Get corresponding formula_uri formula_uri = tool_to_uri.get(func_name) if not formula_uri: print(f"Error: Could not find Formula URI for tool {func_name}") continue # Call the tool result = client.call_tool(formula_uri, func_name, args) # Print result (truncate if too long) if len(str(result)) > 200: print(f"Tool result: {str(result)[:200]}...\n") else: print(f"Tool result: {result}\n") # Add tool result to message list tool_message = { "role": "tool", "tool_call_id": tool_call.id, "name": func_name, "content": result } messages.append(tool_message)print("\nConversation completed!")# Cleanupclient.close()

This process demonstrates how thinking models use deep reasoning to plan and execute complex multi-step tasks when thinking is enabled. Detailed reasoning steps (reasoning_content) are preserved in the context to ensure accurate tool use at every stage.

import os
import requests
BASE_URL = "https://api.moonshot.cn/v1"
API_KEY = os.environ["MOONSHOT_API_KEY"]
FORMULA_URI = "moonshot/web-search:latest"
def call(method: str, path: str, body: dict | None = None) -> dict:
resp = requests.request(
method,
BASE_URL + path,
headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {API_KEY}"},
json=body,
timeout=120,
)
resp.raise_for_status()
return resp.json()
# 1. 获取工具声明
tools = call("GET", f"/formulas/{FORMULA_URI}/tools")["tools"]
messages = [
{"role": "system", "content": "你是 Kimi，由 Moonshot AI 提供的人工智能助手。"},
{"role": "user", "content": "月之暗面最近有什么消息"},
]
while True:
# 2. 带上工具声明请求模型（每次请求都要带上完整的 tools）
resp = call("POST", "/chat/completions",
{"model": "kimi-k3.1-pro", "messages": messages, "tools": tools})
message = resp["choices"][0]["message"]
tool_calls = message.get("tool_calls") or []
if not tool_calls:
# 没有 tool_calls，输出最终回答
print(message["content"])
break
# 原样保留 assistant 消息（含 tool_calls），后续轮次必须带上
messages.append({k: v for k, v in message.items()
if k in ("role", "content", "tool_calls")})
for tc in tool_calls:
fn = tc["function"]
# 3. 按 tool_calls 原样执行 fiber（arguments 原样透传，此步产生 tool_call 计费）
fiber = call("POST", f"/formulas/{FORMULA_URI}/fibers",
{"name": fn["name"], "arguments": fn["arguments"]})
ctx = fiber.get("context", {})
result = ctx.get("output") or ctx.get("encrypted_output") or ""
# 4. 以 role=tool 消息回传结果，tool_call_id 与 tool_calls[].id 一一对齐
messages.append({"role": "tool", "tool_call_id": tc["id"], "content": result})

Grok Bot 1.0正式发布！马斯克教AI和你的团队一起工作

0%

展开列表

机器之心

原创

35分钟前

Grok Bot 1.0正式发布！马斯克教AI和你的团队一起工作

感觉 xAI 改成 SpaceX Super Intelligence 之后，马斯克在 AI 上很久没有过什么大动静了。

就在刚刚，Grok Bot 1.0 版本正式发布了。

「机器人可以共享，并且比以往任何时候都更具协作性和能力。」

按照 SpaceX Super Intelligence 的说法，新版的 Grok Bot 可以被整个团队共享，能被拉进 Slack、Microsoft Teams 和视频会议，会在讨论里看出谁在说什么、哪件事还没人接，然后主动举手说「这个我来」。

换句话说，它会像一个真正的同事那样，和你一起开会、一起工作。

虽然类同事的合作智能体早已经不是什么新鲜事，但从宣传视频里来看，Grok Bot 1.0 延续了 Grok 自然语音沟通的传统优势，高效自然的写作方式，特别像一个真人。似乎还可以创建和调用其他的智能体 Bot，无缝协作。而且，Grok Bot 的形象看上去非常可爱。

还有，从视频里看，马斯克要卖耳机了？

三个月，从内部原型到「转正」

Grok Bot 第一次露面，是在三个月前。

今年 8 月 11 日，xAI 首次推出 Grok Bot beta 版，定位是「可以交付真实工作的 AI 队友」。

它最初是一个内部原型，后来在公司里火了起来，各个团队用它处理销售、市场活动、行政运营、修 bug 等工作。官方博客里描述过几个内部场景，销售 Bot 会把通话记录整理进 CRM 并起草跟进邮件，运营 Bot 会给新员工安排工位、处理 Gmail 里收到的发票，工程 Bot 能在产品界面里复现 bug、提交工单，再把修复任务交给专门负责调试的 Bot。

当时 Grok Bot 最大的卖点，是每个 Bot 都有一台自己的云端电脑。

这意味着它能像人一样登录各种工具、在网页和应用之间来回切换，就算某个平台没有干净的 API 或 MCP 接口，它也能直接在界面上把活干完。你合上电脑去吃饭，它也能继续工作。

beta 版首批开放给 SuperGrok 系列订阅用户，以及 Cursor Pro、Ultra、Teams 等付费用户。不过，beta 版的 Bot 本质上还是「个人助理」，它服务的是创建它的那个人。

Grok Bot 1.0 更新了什么？

Grok Bot 1.0 的升级有三个关键词，多人协作、主动出击、能力更强。我们逐一拆开来看。

多人协作：一个 Bot，全组共用

这次最核心的变化，是 Team Bots。

过去一个 Bot 只认一个主人，现在团队里的每个人都可以和同一个 Bot 协作。共享方式也更灵活，可以只分享给特定的人或小组，也可以直接把它拉进 Slack 或 Microsoft Teams。

更有意思的是它的学习方式。随着和不同的人打交道，Bot 会逐渐了解团队在做什么、每个人负责什么、各自有什么偏好，对每个人都越来越有用。

在多人对话里，Bot 能跟上好几个人之间的讨论，搞清楚谁参与了、各自在说什么，然后在合适的时候补充信息，或者主动提出接手某项工作。

此外，Bot 还能参加视频会议。它通过会议聊天框参与讨论，把之前对话里的相关信息带进来，同时记下会上做出的决定。

主动出击：不用派活，自己找活

如果说共享解决的是「谁能用」，那么主动性解决的就是「什么时候用」。

1.0 的 Bot 可以持续盯着进行中的项目，发现哪里需要处理，再根据自己对团队目标、流程和优先级的理解，提出下一步建议。

举个产品发布的例子。Bot 看到某个截止日期快到了，就会提前把团队需要的材料准备好。它也会追踪没收尾的任务，和其他 Bot 协调分工，遇到需要人来判断的决策，再把相关的人拉进来。

我们知道，beta 版的 Grok Bot 是「把工作交给 AI 队友」的一种方式，而到了 1.0，这些队友已经能理解团队在做的事和做事的人，可以像其他同事一样主动做出贡献。

越用越懂：一个人教会，全组受益

Team Bot 会在工作中持续积累对团队的理解。它会记住每个人的习惯和已经做过的决定，也会吸收不同成员的专业经验。

这里有一个很实用的设计。当某个人教会 Bot 一种更好的做事方法，这个改进会惠及所有使用它的人。 Bot 自己也会根据从团队里学到的东西，反过来建议调整自己的工作方式。

放进公共频道的 AI，安全自然是绕不开的问题。为此，xAI 加了几道防护：

尊重权限：Bot 遵守每个人各自的访问权限

敏感操作先问：执行敏感操作前会先征求同意

公开前把关：在公开频道分享信息前，会判断这条信息适不适合公开

xAI 的意思是，有了这些防护，团队才敢把更多责任交给 Bot，同时仍然掌握它能看什么、能做什么。

能力更强：更快、更稳、更省

除了协作方式的变化，Bot 本身的能力也有一轮升级。相比 beta 版，主要改进包括：

浏览器操作更稳：浏览网站更可靠，登录流程更顺畅，任务中断更少

文档和演示更好：写出的文档、做出的 PPT 质量更高，还能生成可交互的 Pages，团队可以一起编辑，也可以让 Bot 持续更新

跨应用能力更强：与 Gmail、Google Calendar、GitHub 等工具的连接得到改进，能直接完成更多工作

审批更聪明：Bot 更清楚哪些操作你已经授权过、哪些还需要再问，少打扰，同时保护敏感信息

新增设置与数据分析：管理员可以管理 Team Bot 掌握的知识，也能看到团队是怎么使用它的

xAI 还提到，新版本完成任务所需的资源更少，效率更高。

从「工具」变成「同事」，早已不是新鲜事

早期的 AI 产品围绕个人效率展开，一个人、一个对话框、一次任务。现在，越来越多的厂商开始把目光投向团队，AI 要面对的是多个人、多个工具、持续运转的项目。

把 AI 拉进工作群当同事，国内的协同办公平台早就在做了。

比如，「豆包工作伙伴」是类似的思路，定位是智能体搭建与协作平台。团队使用的工作伙伴可以直接添加到工作群里，共享群内上下文，供群里所有成员共同使用；它会在使用者已有的权限范围内，连通消息、文档、会议、任务和业务系统，主动帮人推进工作。

飞书「工作小队」可以实现多个工作伙伴组成一支小队，其中一个担任队长，负责接收任务、拆解工作、调度成员、交付成果。协作方式也被做成了模板，有路由、专家会诊、圆桌讨论、接力、生产评审、红蓝对抗等 8 种。Grok Bot 1.0 里「一个 Bot 和另一个 Bot 配合」的场景，在这里已经被产品化成了一套标准流程。

千问办公今年 8 月正式上线，深度接入钉钉生态，在钉钉工作台里就能直接唤起。每个空间配一位数字员工小 Q，关联钉钉群聊、文档、表格等作为共同上下文，团队成员直接在 IM 里给它交办任务。Grok Bot 与之如出一辙。

几家产品的思路高度相似。共享给团队、接入真实的工作软件、长期记忆、权限对齐、主动推进任务，这几乎已经成了「AI 同事」类产品的标配清单。

飞书和钉钉本身就是团队工作地方，聊天记录、文档、审批流都长在同一个平台上。Grok Bot 没有自己的办公平台，只能带着一台云端电脑，去 Slack、Teams 和视频会议里「上门打工」。好处是不挑平台，哪里有活去哪里；代价是对团队上下文的掌握，要靠一次次对话慢慢积累。

Grok Bot 1.0 即日起上线，用户可以为自己创建 Bot，也可以分享给团队，或者拉进 Slack、Microsoft Teams 和视频会议。目前桌面端提供 macOS 版本下载。

具体权限上，Team Bots 面向 Team 和 Enterprise 套餐开放；会议功能面向 Team、Enterprise 和 Ultra 套餐开放，企业版管理员需要在设置中手动开启。

感兴趣的读者可以试试看，欢迎在评论区分享使用感受。

xAI.content:
# Grok LLM

## Overview

GrokLLMService provides access to Grok's language models through an OpenAI-compatible interface. It inherits from OpenAILLMService and supports streaming responses, function calling, and context management with Grok's unique reasoning capabilities.

<Card title="Grok LLM API Reference" icon="code" href="https://reference-server.pipecat.ai/en/latest/api/pipecat.services.xai.llm.html"
Pipecat's API methods for Grok integration

<Card title="Example Implementation" icon="play" href="https://github.com/pipecat-ai/pipecat/blob/main/examples/function-calling/function-calling-grok.py"
Complete example with function calling

<Card title="Grok Documentation" icon="book" href="https://docs.x.ai/docs/api-reference#chat-completions"
Official Grok API documentation and features

### X.AI Platform
Access Grok models and manage API keys

## Installation

To use Grok services, install the required dependencies:
uv add "pipecat-ai[grok]"

## Prerequisites

### Grok Account Setup

Before using Grok LLM services, you need:

- X.AI Account: Sign up at X.AI Console
- API Key: Generate an API key from your console dashboard
- Model Selection: Choose from available Grok models

### Required Environment Variables

- XAI_API_KEY: Your X.AI API key for authentication

## Configuration

X.AI API key for authentication. RaisesValueError when empty.

Base URL for Grok API endpoint.

Deprecated since 0.0.105, removed in 2.0.0. Usesettings=GrokLLMService.Settings(model=...) instead.

Runtime-configurable settings. See Settings below.

### Settings

Runtime-configurable settings passed via thesettings constructor argument using GrokLLMService.Settings(...). These can be updated mid-conversation with LLMUpdateSettingsFrame. See Service Settings for details.

<ParamField path="reasoning_effort" type="Literal['none', 'low', 'medium', 'high', 'xhigh'] | None" default="None"

How much the model thinks before answering. Accepted values vary by model:"low", "medium", and "high" on the Grok 4 reasoning models, "xhigh" on
grok-4.6 and later, and "none" on models that can turn reasoning off. The
non-reasoning models, including the default model, reject the parameter. When
unset, xAI's per-model default applies.

Per-category content guidelines, for example[{"type": "policy", "category": "profanity", "behavior": "decline"}]. xAI
documents the categories "nsfw", "violence", and "profanity" and the
behavior "decline". A category left out keeps the model's default handling.
Multi-agent models reject guidelines. When unset, xAI's default moderation
applies.

This service also inherits settings fromOpenAILLMService. See OpenAI LLM Settings for additional parameters. The service defaults to model="grok-4.20-non-reasoning" when no model is specified.

## Usage

### Basic Setup
import os
from pipecat.services.xai.llm import GrokLLMService

llm = GrokLLMService(
    api_key=os.getenv("XAI_API_KEY"),
)

### With Custom Settings
from pipecat.services.xai.llm import GrokLLMService

llm = GrokLLMService(
    api_key=os.getenv("XAI_API_KEY"),
    settings=GrokLLMService.Settings(
        model="grok-4.6",
        temperature=0.7,
        top_p=0.9,
        max_completion_tokens=1024,
        reasoning_effort="low",
    ),
)

## Notes

- Token usage is reported once per completion at the end of each request.
- Grok supports prompt caching and reasoning tokens, which are tracked in usage metrics when available.

xAI.title: Grok编程智能体泄露大量机密信息，部分涉及SpaceXSI
xAI.description: 安全公司Claroc研究发现，xAI旗下Grok Build因URL随机化机制设计缺陷，导致数千用户项目可被公开枚举访问，泄露内容涵盖医疗记录、军事合同名单及SpaceXSI自身24个内部应用的机密文件。
xAI.content:
# Grok编程智能体泄露大量机密信息，部分涉及SpaceXSI

安全公司Claroc研究发现，xAI旗下Grok Build因URL随机化机制设计缺陷，导致数千用户项目可被公开枚举访问，泄露内容涵盖医疗记录、军事合同名单及SpaceXSI自身24个内部应用的机密文件。

SpaceXSI旗下的Vibe编程智能体Grok Build正从数千名用户处泄露数据，其中一些是专有商业信息和其他敏感机密，而受影响者甚至包括马斯克旗下提供该平台服务的公司本身，新研究显示。

这些信息是通过Grok Build用户用来与他人分享应用的链接暴露出来的。Grok采取了随机化URL的措施，理论上只有知道确切URL的人才能访问其中存储的数据。然而，该平台开发者的一项设计决策完全破坏了这一目标，使得任何人都能够枚举出数千个正在运行的Grok Build项目。除极少数情况外，点击这些链接就能打开应用并查看与之关联的所有数据。

本该做好的一件事

安全公司Claroc的研究显示，暴露的数据包括内部商业计划、广告提案、体检结果、某豪华游轮公司的厨房清单，以及员工姓名和身份证号。讽刺的是，部分敏感数据来自SpaceXSI（目前已合并的SpaceX与xAI的新名称）自己构建的二十多个应用。Claroc发现了其中24个应用，文档样本中包括一份标注为机密的新入职企业销售团队成员的入职计划、一份涵盖594个客户的销售区域地图、销售团队工具的内部系统地址，以及广告提案。

“我们感到震惊，”Claroc在周二的一篇文章中表示。“制造Grok的这家公司，自己的内部资料竟然对任何持有链接的人开放，而我们从未获得过这些链接。如果销售团队为此购买了一款工具，它本应被置于公司登录系统之后，仅对团队开放。但这是用AI构建的，结果对任何持有链接的人都公开可见。”

Claroc于周日通知了SpaceXSI这一隐私泄露问题。在无人回应的情况下，Claroc的一名官员在X平台上@了马斯克和Grok负责人马特·帕尔默，提醒他们注意这一威胁。截至本文发布时，几乎所有数据仍可访问，唯一明显的例外是那24个SpaceXSI应用的内容——周一晚间它们仍在泄露信息。在Ars就本文内容发送询问邮件后的几小时内，SpaceXSI开始删除这些链接。截至本文发布时，这24个应用的链接均返回“应用未找到”的错误提示。

Claroc还发现了属于其他Grok Build用户的敏感数据，其中一些用户供职于财富500强公司和一家国防承包商。受影响的组织及其泄露数据包括：

一家秘鲁建筑公司：职业健康仪表盘，包含3784名工人的体检记录

特斯拉：服务中心评分表，列出22名技师的生产力与奖金状态

一家美国海军船舶工程承包商：海军后勤支持合同下108人的人员名单

一家知名豪华游轮公司：某游轮厨房清单，列出船员全名及员工编号

一家医疗保健公司：医院员工应用，包含约3565名员工的姓名和编号名单

一家美国IT服务公司：向大型零售客户提交的机密提案，含硬件物料清单

一家挪威-芬兰航空航天与国防集团：某美国工厂爆炸物建筑的装载板及装载流程，以及其健康安全环境培训矩阵

一家美国住宅建筑公司：销售通话表，含约583名购房意向客户、预算及融资情况备注

一家马来西亚控股公司：37个开发项目的监控表，含利润及销售数据

一家汽车运输公司：报价系统，含约4000份车辆运输订单、价格及利润率

一家美国数据中心托管服务商：向欧洲某运营商提交的机密IP中转提案

Claroc联合创始人兼首席技术官阿萨夫·阿普罗兹佩尔表示，他正在通知相关公司。在与该豪华游轮公司的首席信息安全官沟通后，该公司“在我们分享发现结果后立即调动了整个安全团队，目前正在着手处理这次Grok泄露事件”。

一个致命缺陷——大多数其他AI平台也存在同样问题

Grok Build的链接分享功能旨在简化应用开发与部署流程。用户可以输入语音或文字，几分钟内就能获得一个可供内部测试的应用。这些链接旨在让开发者能够快速将应用提供给授权用户使用。链接最左侧包含两个或更多“骰子词”，即随机生成的短语，例如“failing chassis traders”，不过用户可以对其进行修改。链接最右侧部分是grok.me。某X广告活动计划的URL为：https://cinder-crane-sand-frost.grok.me。

这一方案本意是防止链接被轻易猜测到。如果设计得当，由三个骰子词组成的短语大约具有38比特的熵值，相当于数十亿种可能组合。其理念——有时被称为基于能力的访问控制——是指持有该URL本身即构成对其背后资源的授权。谷歌长期以来一直采用这种技术，使URL既便于分享又难以猜测。该平台上的一个分享链接可能是这样的：https://docs.google.com/document/d/1BxiMVs0XRA5nFMdKvBdBZjgmUUqptlbs74OgvE2upms/edit

然而，SpaceXSI在实现这一机制的方式上存在一个致命缺陷。与谷歌链接中随机部分位于域名右侧不同，Grok Build链接的随机部分被放在了域名左侧。这使得这些链接可以通过被动DNS服务被轻易枚举出来。此类服务会监控中心化的DNS查询服务器。当服务器查询请求一个此前从未出现过的URL的IP地址时，该事务会被记录到一个可公开搜索的数据库中。如果Grok采用了谷歌的方式，这些链接本应对被动DNS搜索者不可见。Meta旗下的智能体Muse，其首席执行官马克·扎克伯格曾表示该产品是从头开始以安全为核心打造的，此前也因同样被发现泄露敏感数据而暂停了其链接分享功能。

ArsTechnica

xAI.title: Elon Musk's Grok AI Leaks Internal Confidential Data: Full Exposure of SpaceX & Tesla Salary, Performance Details, and Patient Privacy Breach
xAI.description: Elon Musk's Grok leaked its own internal confidential information ... 000 applications built with Grok are accessible without login ... The most notable case is that SpaceXSI, the merged entity of SpaceX and xAI owned by Elon Musk, and X are also on the list of affected parties.
xAI.content:
# Elon Musk's Grok leaked its own internal confidential information, fully exposing the salary and performance details of SpaceX and Tesla, and even patient privacy was not spared.

量子位2026-11-12 12:06

Build apps with Grok, and you will get the one-click unboxing feature as a free complimentary bonus.

Grok never fails to deliver absurdly unexpected blunders that catch people completely off guard.

Just recently, security firm Claroc discovered that more than 35,000 applications built with Grok are accessible without login, and some of them directly expose corporate confidential information and personal privacy data.

The most notable case is that SpaceXSI, the merged entity of SpaceX and xAI owned by Elon Musk, and X are also on the list of affected parties.

Employee onboarding plans, sales customer data, advertising proposals... even the most sensitive internal information of these companies has been leaked to the public.

Moreover, Tesla, which has not been merged with the above entities, did not escape the leak either. A service center scorecard posted the names, work efficiency and bonus details of 22 technicians on a public web page.

What is more ridiculous is that not only internal employees who use the product have been affected, the leaked content also involves sensitive information of ordinary users.

The leaked data includes ICU patients' laboratory test results, imaging examination records, ventilator usage logs, and plaintext account passwords of enterprise employees.

It is almost unbelievable that using Grok can give strangers one-click full access to all your private information for free.

## What exactly has been leaked?

Specifically, at the beginning of the incident, Claroc tested 43,551 Grok Build application addresses (37,571 of which are still online), and found that 94.7% of the online applications can be opened without logging in.

Although most of these applications are trivial AI-generated tools made by ordinary users, such as mini-games and calculators...

After screening through models and manual sampling, Claroc estimates that about 650 to 800 of these applications contain private data.

The involved institutions include SpaceXSI, X, and 30 other enterprises, 6 of which are listed in the Fortune 500.

How sensitive is this leaked data? A few examples will make it clear:

1. A brief for ICU patients, including patients' laboratory test results, imaging examination records and ventilator usage status.

2. A working hour management application for a contractor, which writes the plaintext passwords of 18 accounts into the script, and anyone who visits the page can download the data.

3. SpaceXSI's internal sales tool, which contains strategic customer accounts, sales business opportunities and internal team information.

4. Tesla service center scorecard, which contains employees' names, work efficiency and bonus details.

......

After going through all the cases, it does seem unreasonable that some users would record their own passwords and medical examination reports in the Vibe Coding tools.

But Grok directly made all this data public to everyone, which is still an extremely unreasonable and flawed design.

So how did this data, which was supposed to only circulate internally within the company, end up on public web pages?

## How did a random link become an entry point to expose all private data?

Simply put, when you use Grok vibecoding, it will assign a unique URL to each published application, in the form of random-name.grok.me.

These random names are composed of several words, and the original design intention is to make them difficult for others to guess. But the problem is, hard-to-guess URLs do not equal secure access permissions.

Claroc found that these application addresses can be found in batches through Passive DNS databases.

To put it simply, every time someone visits a website, the computer needs to query the server address corresponding to the domain name through DNS. Some DNS resolution services collect these query records and store them in a searchable database.

Thus, a discovery path is formed:

Someone visits the application → the DNS query leaves a record → the domain name is added to the passive DNS database → external personnel find the application addresses in batches.

If the access permission of the application is set to "Anyone with the link", then anyone who finds the URL can open it directly.

In other words, Grok uses random URLs to increase the difficulty of applications being discovered, but it does not really solve the access control problem.

For the sake of fairness, Claroc also conducted a control test on ChatGPT applications: their application addresses may also be included in passive DNS, but the sharing panel is set to "Only me" by default. Even if others find the URL, they cannot access it.

This is one clear advantage of ChatGPT over Grok!

In addition, in order to verify whether the code generated by Grok is reliable and how it handles team permissions.

Claroc later used fictional data to build a customer management application for a four-person sales team on its own.

Although Grok did automatically add Google and X login functions, the researchers found a very low-level error after checking the code:

The application adds the visitor to the team first, and then checks whether he is a team member. That is, it pulls you into the group first, and then checks if you are a group member.

Which means everyone will be recognized as a group member...

Subsequently, the researchers logged in with a Google account that had never been invited, and they not only saw all the customer data, but also successfully modified one record and deleted another.

In other words, as long as you want to access, the door of Grok is always open for you.

## Official Response and Follow-up Progress

After the incident was exposed, SpaceXSI told the media that all applications are private before the creator actively shares them, and publishing an application requires multiple steps.

The company also stated that its employee accounts are set to "Only you" by default, and users need to actively modify the permissions to make the application public.

But Claroc said that in its paid accounts used for testing, the pre-selected option on the publishing panel is "Anyone with the link".

The key point here is:

Being private before publication, and who is allowed to access the application by default when publishing, are two completely separate issues.

If you click through the entire "publish" process, the pre-selected access scope will still be all people who hold the link. Even if you confirm multiple times, the system will not automatically add a list of team members to the access permission list.

The researchers also verified Grok's existing permission control functions.

After switching to the "Only you" mode, strangers will be denied access to the page and data interface; unpublishing can also take the application offline within a few seconds.

So Grok does have usable protection measures. The problem is whether these measures are actually enabled when users publish internal tools.

At present, this incident has sparked heated discussions on X. Some people think that it is the users themselves who opened the permission incorrectly, while others think that Grok's default permission setting is problematic.

As for the follow-up processing, SpaceXSI did not start removing the relevant links until several hours after Ars Technica sent the interview email.

As of the release of the report, all 24 applications created by SpaceXSI and X employees have been taken offline.

However, a large number of applications created by other users are still accessible, and Claroc has begun to contact the affected institutions on its own.

As for whether the platform will actively notify other affected customers, Ars Technica has not yet received a clear response.

### Reference Links

[1]https://arstechnica.com/security/2026/11/grok-build-coding-agent-leaks-oodles-of-confidential-info-some-belonging-to-spacexsi/

[2]https://blog.claroc.io/ghostshares-grok-build-apps/

This article is from the WeChat official account QbitAI, written by henry, and is republished with authorization from 36Kr.

Access Grok models and manage API keys

## Installation

To use Grok Realtime services, install the required dependencies:
uv add "pipecat-ai[grok]"

## Prerequisites

### xAI Account Setup

Before using Grok Realtime services, you need:

- xAI Account: Sign up at xAI Console
- API Key: Generate a Grok API key from your account dashboard
- Model Access: Ensure access to Grok Voice Agent models
- Usage Limits: Configure appropriate usage limits and billing

### Required Environment Variables

- XAI_API_KEY: Your xAI API key for authentication

### Key Features

- Real-time Speech-to-Speech: Direct audio processing with low latency
- Multilingual Support: Support for multiple languages
- Voice Activity Detection: Server-side VAD for automatic speech detection
- Function Calling: Seamless support for external functions and tool integration
- Multiple Voice Options: Various voice personalities available
- WebSocket Support: Real-time bidirectional audio streaming

## Configuration

### GrokRealtimeLLMService

xAI API key for authentication.

WebSocket base URL for the Grok Realtime API. Override for custom deployments.

<ParamField path="session_properties" type="SessionProperties" default="None" deprecated

Deprecated since 0.0.105, removed in 2.0.0. Usesettings=GrokRealtimeLLMService.Settings(session_properties=...) instead.

<ParamField path="settings" type="GrokRealtimeLLMService.Settings" default="None"

Runtime-configurable settings. See Settings below.

Whether to start with audio input paused.

### Settings

Runtime-configurable settings passed via thesettings constructor argument using GrokRealtimeLLMService.Settings(...). These can be updated mid-conversation with LLMUpdateSettingsFrame. See Service Settings for details.

Parameter | Type | Default | Description 
---|---|---|---
model | str | "grok-voice-latest" | Model identifier. Defaults to xAI's recommended Voice Agent alias. Set at connection time, so runtime changes are not applied. (Inherited from base settings.) 
system_instruction | str | None | System instruction/prompt. (Inherited from base settings.) 
session_properties | SessionProperties | SessionProperties() | Session-level configuration (voice, audio config, tools, etc.). 

NOT_GIVEN and None values are omitted, letting the service use its own
defaults. Only parameters that are explicitly set are included.

### SessionProperties

Parameter | Type | Default | Description 
---|---|---|---
instructions | str | None | System instructions for the assistant. 
voice | str | "eve" | Voice the model uses to respond. Accepts any built-in voice ID (see xAI's voice catalogue) or a custom voice ID from the Custom Voices API. Case-insensitive. 
turn_detection | TurnDetection | TurnDetection(type="server_vad") | Turn detection configuration. Set to None for manual turn detection. 
audio | AudioConfiguration | None | Configuration for input and output audio formats. 
tools | ToolsSchema | list[FunctionSchema | DirectFunction] | list[GrokTool] | None | None | Available tools: web_search, x_search, file_search, mcp, or custom function tools. 
reasoning | Reasoning | None | Reasoning effort controls. Set effort="high" to enable reasoning or effort="none" to disable. 
resumption | SessionResumption | None | Session resumption opt-in. Set enabled=True to cache conversation history for reconnection. 
replace | dict[str, str] | None | Pronunciation replacement map applied before TTS (e.g., {"Acme": "Ack-mee"}). 

### TurnDetection

Theturn_detection field in SessionProperties configures voice activity detection and turn management:

Parameter | Type | Default | Description 
---|---|---|---
type | Literal["server_vad"] | None | "server_vad" | Detection type: "server_vad" for automatic detection, None for manual control. 
threshold | float | None | VAD activation threshold (0.1–0.9). Higher values require louder audio. 
silence_duration_ms | int | None | Milliseconds of silence before the server ends the user turn. 
prefix_padding_ms | int | None | Audio (ms) included before detected speech start. 
idle_timeout_ms | int | None | Milliseconds of silence after assistant response before proactive check-in. 

### AudioConfiguration

Theaudio field in SessionProperties accepts an AudioConfiguration with input and output sub-configurations:

AudioInput (audio.input):

Parameter | Type | Default | Description 
---|---|---|---
format | AudioFormat | None | Input audio format. Supports PCMAudioFormat (configurable rate), PCMUAudioFormat (8kHz), or PCMAAudioFormat (8kHz). 
transcription | InputAudioTranscription | None | Transcription settings. Set model="grok-transcribe" for streaming user captions. 
transport | Literal["json", "binary"] | None | Wire path for input audio. 

AudioOutput (audio.output):

Parameter | Type | Default | Description 
---|---|---|---
format | AudioFormat | None | Output audio format. Same format options as input. 
speed | float | None | Playback speed multiplier (0.7–1.5). 
transport | Literal["json", "binary"] | None | Wire path for assistant audio. 

Grok PCM audio supports sample rates: 8000, 11025, 16000, 22050, 24000, 32000, 44100, and 48000 Hz.

InputAudioTranscription (audio.input.transcription):

Parameter | Type | Default | Description 
---|---|---|---
model | str | None | Transcription model. Use "grok-transcribe" for streaming user captions. 
language_hint | str | None | BCP-47 language code to bias ASR (e.g., "en-US"). 
keyterms | list[str] | None | Domain terms to bias transcription (max 100 terms, ≤50 chars each). 

### Built-in Tools

Grok provides several built-in tools in addition to custom function tools:

Tool | Type | Description 
---|---|---
WebSearchTool | web_search | Search the web for current information 
XSearchTool | x_search | Search X (Twitter) for posts. Supports allowed_x_handles filter. 
FileSearchTool | file_search | Search uploaded document collections by vector_store_ids 
McpTool | mcp | Remote MCP tool configuration managed by xAI 

## Usage

### Basic Setup
import os
from pipecat.services.xai.realtime.llm import GrokRealtimeLLMService

llm = GrokRealtimeLLMService(
    api_key=os.getenv("XAI_API_KEY"),
)

### With Session Configuration
from pipecat.services.xai.realtime.llm import GrokRealtimeLLMService
from pipecat.services.xai.realtime.events import (
    SessionProperties,
    TurnDetection,
    AudioConfiguration,
    AudioInput,
    AudioOutput,
    PCMAudioFormat,
)

session_properties = SessionProperties(
    instructions="You are a helpful assistant.",
    voice="rex",
    turn_detection=TurnDetection(type="server_vad"),
    audio=AudioConfiguration(
        input=AudioInput(format=PCMAudioFormat(rate=16000)),
        output=AudioOutput(format=PCMAudioFormat(rate=16000)),
    ),
)

llm = GrokRealtimeLLMService(
    api_key=os.getenv("XAI_API_KEY"),
    settings=GrokRealtimeLLMService.Settings(
        session_properties=session_properties,
    ),
)

### With Built-in Tools
from pipecat.services.xai.realtime.llm import GrokRealtimeLLMService
from pipecat.services.xai.realtime.events import (
    SessionProperties,
    WebSearchTool,
    XSearchTool,
)

llm = GrokRealtimeLLMService(
    api_key=os.getenv("XAI_API_KEY"),
    settings=GrokRealtimeLLMService.Settings(
        session_properties=SessionProperties(
            instructions="You are a helpful assistant with access to web search.",
            voice="eve",
            tools=[
                WebSearchTool(),
                XSearchTool(allowed_x_handles=["@elonmusk"]),
            ],
        ),
    ),
)

### Updating Settings at Runtime

Asession_properties delta replaces the stored SessionProperties whole, so fields it leaves unset (such as tools, turn detection, and transcription) fall back to their defaults. Copy the full session config and change the fields you need:
from pipecat.frames.frames import LLMUpdateSettingsFrame
from pipecat.services.xai.realtime.llm import GrokRealtimeLLMSettings

session_properties = session_properties.model_copy(update={"voice": "eve"})

await worker.queue_frame(
    LLMUpdateSettingsFrame(
        delta=GrokRealtimeLLMSettings(
            system_instruction="Now speak in Spanish.",
            session_properties=session_properties,
        )
    )
)

## Methods

### delete_conversation_item
await service.delete_conversation_item(item_id: str)

Delete a conversation item by ID. Sends aconversation.item.delete event to the server.

Parameters:

- item_id (str): ID of the conversation item to delete

### force_message
await service.force_message(text: str)

Speak a hard-coded TTS line without involving the LLM. Sends aforce_message conversation item. The server automatically injects the response lifecycle, so no response.create call is needed.

Parameters:

- text (str): Verbatim text to synthesize and play
